literal_units: Python Unicode codepoints, exact positive multiple of side*side; no cleaning/padding/filtering
start_quarters: 0..3 clockwise turns from supplied mask before selected direction

functions.settings_route: (*, side, holes, start_quarters=0, direction='clockwise', hole_scan='row-major', cipher_serialization='row-major')
functions.encrypt: (payload, *, side, holes, start_quarters=0, direction='clockwise', hole_scan='row-major', cipher_serialization='row-major')
functions.decrypt: (ciphertext, *, side, holes, start_quarters=0, direction='clockwise', hole_scan='row-major', cipher_serialization='row-major')

model_limits: No authentication or historical-cipher validity from roundtrip alone
Source-supported physical start/face/scan/serialization must be registered later after independent source freeze
